title: Raqeeb
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Raqeeb whom he refers to as a villain in a love story. S01 E103.

title: Ibtedaaye Ishq
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the term *Ibtedaaye Ishq* which means beginning of love. S01 E130.

title: Similarities
desc: Javed Akhtar notes poets' diverse interpretations of love and friendship. S01 E108.

title: Charagh
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the term Charagh which means a lamp. He says every poet has used the term lamp in different contexts such as lamp as light in darkness, lamp as a guide, lamp as a son,. S01 E131.

title: Ghar
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the difference between the terms house & home, he says house is just a structure where one can find shelter while home is where people reside together in love & harmony. S01 E115.

title: Sadhu
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about sadhu being used as a metaphor to describe a positive human. He says a person must be simple & strong internally & externally just like a sadhu to deal with various. S01 E90.

title: Rahe Sameep Badeyn
desc: Javed Akhtar says one imbibes the culture he/she blossoms in, if one is born in a good environment, he/she ought to imbibe the goodness but, if the environment is faulty, it directly reflects. S01 E71.

title: Jo Jako Gun
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about how humans are evolving & so are their inclinations. Sweetness can be bittered & a bitter person can turn sweet, it's a matter of time, perspective & what they receive. S01 E45.

title: Ati Agaadh Ati
desc: Javed Akhtar explains how comparison only breeds jealousy. He says everyone should consider a home where ever they feel the most peaceful, be it places, emotions, people etc. S01 E51.

title: Chori Karai Nihaye
desc: Javed Akhtar says a person who is quick to judge others for their mistakes is one who swells with pride by doing a small deed of goodness. S01 E64.

title: Sundar Than Na
desc: When a person moves forward in life, what is the key thing that a person must remember? Javed Akhar talks about this important life lesson in this episode. S01 E82.

title: Aawat Hi Harsh
desc: Is it wrong to be ambitious and have a desire to do or buy things that one likes? Javed Akhtar gives a beautiful answer to this ever-popping question in human minds. S01 E84.
